notes.title: Changelog for Update May 26
notes.content:
- Fixed issue that prevented getting the achievement "Master of Blockland" at the end of World 1. 
- Fixed issue that awarded 2 extra lives when getting 50 and 51k instead of only 1 at 50k points. 
- Fixed animation of Player 2 pushing right in World 2.

notes.title: Fixed ending issue
notes.content: Ending vignettes were not showing properly, only a purple screen was shown instead. Now it should show properly and can be skipped by pressing the push/action button/key

notes.title: Data migration
notes.content: Added migration of old save data to the new achievements system. If you already had some save data in the game you'll be rewarded with the new achievents that correspond with that data :)

notes.title: The big update!
notes.content:
[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added Asus Aura Support
[*]The player sprite now blinks at the beginning of the stage to make it easier to find on the level
[*]It is now easier to get 3 stars on every level
[*]Some achievements were very hard to get. In this update we have changed them to make them more achievable
[*]Levels are unlocked as soon as you enter them instead of at the end of the world. Now the game saves every level and it is accessible from the "Select Stage" menu. 
[*] Fixed some other minor bugs 
[/list]

[h3]Asus Coloring[/h3]

We partnered with Asus to bring their Aura lighting technology to the game. 
Supported devices will get: 
[list]
[*]Light key mappings colored in keyboards. 
[*]Color animations when game over, hurry up and end of stage animations. 
[/list]

More info: https://rog.asus.com/forum/showthread.php?120213-Install-Armoury-Crate-amp-Enable-In-Game-Effects-for-Supported-Games&p=813225#post813225

[h3] Quality of Life Changes [/h3]

We have implemented several quality of life changes like the character blinking at the beginning of the stage to make it easier to know where you start from or the saving and loading after every stage. 
Thank you all who provided feedback and please continue to do so! We are happy to listen to it and change what we can to make the best game possible. 

[h3] New Achievements! [/h3]

Some of you told us how difficult it is to get all the achievements in the game. When we added the achievements to the game we wanted to provide a challenge to players but of course we didn't want things to be impossible.  We have changed them to make it way more achievable so you can complete all of them :)

Thank you to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/dwaggienite]dwaggienite[/url] for reaching out and helping making a more realistic achievement list.

notes.title: Pushy and Pully will be available on Steam starting May 5th
notes.content:
Pushy and Pully in Blockland, a 2-player co-operative retro game created by Resistance Studio and recently featured in Steam Games Festival, will be releasing on Steam on May 5th. The game, inspired by classics like Pengo, Don’t Pull, Snow Bros, and Bomberman, will see retro gaming fans embark on a journey through a mysterious planet.

Travel through 50 hand crafted levels, complete challenging puzzles, fight pixel-created creatures, and recover your spaceship to escape Blockland. Enjoy the classic Match-3 mechanic by joining three or more blocks of the same color to unlock power-ups, and defeat more than one monster at the same time to get extra combo points. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35388627/c8e9a43c09ef98337eec0f48f695e337fa65c87d.gif[/img]

Pushy and Pully in Blockland lets you play solo or with a friend, for an old school couch gaming experience, or online by using [b]Remote Play Together[/b] on Steam. You can even invite a friend to join your local game session without them having the game! 

Challenge your Steam friends and discover who gets the perfect score in the retro flavoured  Hi-Score table. Play and save your scores in the ranking as you did in the 80’s and 90’s during the glorious arcade days.  Pushy and Pully in Blockland will be released on PC  on May 5th. Xbox One, Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4 release dates will be announced soon. 
  
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1107820/Pushy_and_Pully_in_Blockland/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35388627/5397205bf5e9e44391ec8835ffbc081cd81c1a39.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Pushy and Pully in Blockland won the Indie Expo Award at Devcom
notes.content:
Pushy and Pully in Blockland was beign showcased at Devcom event in Cologne, Germany on 18-19 August.

It was nominated for the Indie Expo Award where the attendants had to select the best game of the event. And Pushy and Pully won! 

Thank you everybody who voted and enjoyed our game. It makes us at Resistance Studio very happy to see that the game is enjoyed so much.

notes.title: The next Pushy and Pully in Blockland private beta is happening soon!
notes.content:
Join the private beta from [b]August 2nd till August 4th[/b]! You will be able to try the complete first world of the game including 10 handcrafted levels with different enemies and a boss fight at the end. During those days you can play as much as you want to try and get the best score possible. Make it to the top of the global leaderboard and[b] you will get an exclusive beta-player T-shirt,[/b] shipping anywhere in the world. 

After the beta ends there will be a survey and all your feedback will be taken in account. The developer wants to make the game as fun and good as possible! The game is still in development and therefore there could be bugs or glitches. If you encounter any of that you can also report it during or after the beta period. 

You can sign up for the beta from the game’s discord server: http://discord.gg/pushyandpully Being part of that community means that you will have access not only to the private betas but also merchandising and raffles, news about the game before anybody else, exclusive content, etc. The developers of the game are also there to answer all your questions.
